target.name: Plantd Materials
target.founder: Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, Josh Dorfman

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $42M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Plantd Materials is a Series B-stage materials company founded by Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, and Josh Dorfman. The company has raised $42M to date. The valuation analysis is constrained by the absence of direct public comparables and a limited set of identifiable private peer transactions in the materials sector.

The stage-progression method was the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($42M) as a proxy for Series B entry value, a 1.9x step-up multiplier—consistent with typical Series B to subsequent-stage progression—yields an implied valuation of $80M. This represents the median point of the derived range.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, centered on $80M. The narrow width of this range reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than cross-validation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable transaction data in the materials subsector, which limits external calibration of the step-up multiplier, and incomplete visibility into company-specific metrics (revenue, unit economics, technology maturity) that typically inform stage-specific valuation bridges. A more robust analysis would benefit from additional private market transactions or revenue-based approaches to triangulate this initial estimate.
